meetings.title: Insights squad standup
segments: Morning. First standup since we locked the plan, so let's check we're all moving. Raj?
I started the SAML spike yesterday afternoon.
Daniel got us an Okta developer tenant, and I have a login working locally already, which is a good sign.
The Azure AD side I haven't touched, because we don't have a sandbox yet.
I'll ask Aisha to chase Arcadia for the Azure AD sandbox today.
That's the piece that decides whether six weeks is real.
The labeling guidelines went out last night, and Tom's two people start labeling today.
I also changed the prompt so theme labels are short noun phrases.
The labels already read a lot more human.
Oh, I saw those this morning. Much better.
On my side, the empty state for small workspaces is done in the prototype.
The Zendesk import step is half done.
And I started on the share to Slack flow.
I'm writing the design doc for incremental assignment.
The short version is, new comments get assigned to the nearest existing theme in real time, and anything that's too far from every theme goes into a holding bucket until the nightly job.
That matches what I was thinking. Can I review it?
Yes, I'll send you the draft after lunch.
I'm wrapping up the online migrations work.
The tool works on the fresh staging snapshot.
Then I start pairing with Raj on SAML tomorrow.
Great. Nothing blocked except the Azure sandbox?
Okay. Thanks all, good energy.
